construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit PDC24-039 (PD Zoning, folder year 2024), status Approved: "PD rezoning from the R-1-8 Zoning District to the R-1-8(PD) Planned Development Zoning District for the construction of 8 new single-family detached residences on 8 lots on a 1.06 gross acre site."

Rezoning from R-1-8 to R-1-8(PD) and eight two-story detached homes on eight lots with a new private street off Roberts Avenue; demolition of an approximately 1,300 sq ft home previously damaged by fire; about 18,160 sq ft of green space and landscaping.

IS/MND list of preparers names Pan-Cal Corporation (David S. Chui, President; Benjamin Chui, Vice President) as applicant, Dahlin Group as architect, Wood Rodgers as civil engineer and Greg Ing & Associates as landscape architect.

Earlier city files on this parcel: PRE15-085 (10 attached and detached homes, applicant Marvin Bamburg, MBA Architects), PRE22-065 (eight-lot subdivision, Marvin Bamburg Associates) and PRE23-174 (eight detached homes, applicant David Chui, Fremont Center Plaza LLC).

City environmental folder ER24-088 states the project was submitted on two adjacent parcels and 1170 and 1190 Roberts Avenue are part of the same project; folder ER24-092 states the review was split back into two separate IS/MNDs as of May 23, 2025.
